surf_owner.text: Thurso East! On its day, one of the best reef breaks in Europe. Long, hollow rights peeling over a flat flagstone reef. Big swell from the north, wind from the south, and you're in heaven. A cold heaven.
Five mill wetsuit, gloves, boots, hood. The water's about six degrees in winter. You don't feel your face, which helps with the wipeouts.
Big surf contests have come here. Pros from Hawaii and Australia, standing on the beach in four layers going 'is it always like this?' Aye. It's always like this.
